# Home illustration expansion

Ten original transparent PNGs generated for the Home studies. Preserve existing natural-material style. Use a single contextual illustration per section; action icons stay outlined.

- devotional-teacup: A cream porcelain teacup on a small saucer, pale sage tea, a tiny chamomile blossom resting beside it, no steam
- prayer-envelope: An ivory cotton-paper envelope partly open with a blank folded prayer note, delicate muted blue silk ribbon tied loosely around it, no writing
- reflection-quill: A natural ivory feather quill beside a small warm gray ceramic ink pot, refined and tactile
- growth-vase: Three delicate white lily-of-the-valley stems in a small pale sage ceramic bud vase
- quiet-window: A small freestanding arched ivory window frame with translucent soft blue glass and warm morning light, no surrounding building
- faith-key: A single vintage small brushed warm brass key on a loosely looped pale sage silk ribbon
- wisdom-scroll: A partly unrolled ivory parchment scroll, blank, two small natural wooden rollers, gently curled paper
- grace-shell: One elegant pale ivory scallop seashell holding a small luminous natural pearl
- hope-nest: A delicate tiny woven twig birds nest with two pale blue eggs and one small white feather
- gratitude-bowl: A small handmade cream ceramic bowl with three ripe figs, one cut revealing muted dusty rose flesh, and a green fig leaf

Subjects are visual metaphors, not doctrinal illustrations. Full-resolution originals are preserved. Add curated semantic assignments rather than assigning artwork by row position. See manifest-home-refresh.json for source provenance and dimensions.
